gift_scope: Whole unrestricted organization; one international cohort candidate, not an SF intervention
status: Conditional best estimate, not validated marginal offer
parameter_basis: Matched 2024 whole expenses / all reported surgeries; includes administration, fundraising, training, outreach and tears. Accounting average, not causal marginal quote.
2024-to-2026 prices, remote/complex expansion and accounting/output mismatch; not estimated inflation. No second overhead haircut.
Reported surgeries may include repeats; only unique care episodes receive first-treatment outcome stream; repeat surgery remains fully costed.
Current provider reports 20% tear cases; working share .8, range .6–.9
Do not apply fistula trial outcomes to perineal tears. Their costs and potential benefits retained/uncredited.
Capacity added beyond public hospitals, NGOs, reserves and donor replacement. Not patient waiting-time catch-up. Current room unknown.
Conservative full operated cohort anchor 21/44 dry, 13/44 partial; favorable transfer .75/.20

Nielsen: 38/44 followed, 37 classified urinary states. All 10 others receive zero durable health (3 persistent, 6 lost, 1 unclassified). No RCT or current portfolio rate. Cautious .4/.3 is a joint transfer scenario, not a lower confidence bound on both fractions.
Explicit preference-utility priors .25/.08, ranges .1–.35 / 0–.15, signed -0.1/-.05 diagnostics
QoL questionnaires and DALY disability weights are not direct QALYs. Recovery does not imply restored social health; no separate mental-health or income credit.
Hard cap on advantage over later public/NGO treatment or recovery, not patient lifetime; actual no-gift waiting-time distribution unavailable.
Delay to care, finite survival and recurrence/declining effect after long-term outcome anchor. No lifetime extension or maternal-death benefit.
Prior .015 per added distinct episode; range0–.1

Gift-date PV total acute harms from every operation/repeat in an added unique episode, including tears; not a per-operation rate. Excludes durable-state worsening. Full present harm without subtracting delayed alternative repair harm is conservative.
Gift-date PV health loss outside patient treatment stream, e.g. displaced other scarce care; no activity multiplier. Do not double count procedure harm.

Unreimbursed public hospital/noncash staff, patient travel/time, family care, including unsuccessful/repeat/tear procedures. Add on all nominal surgery equivalents. Gross resources, not net induced societal spending.

geography.note: US administration is a resource cost, not local health benefit. No local multiplier.

funding_boundary: No verified unfunded 2026 tranche. Positive prior permits research ranking, not a guarantee a gift adds care. Public capacity and other NGOs are baseline. Independent donor displacement and eventual patient catch-up are different counterfactuals.
